title: DFT total-energy of bulk Si (64 atoms)
action: Perform DFT total-energy calculation for a 64-atom bulk Si supercell using the LDA exchange-correlation functional. Use converged k-point sampling and plane-wave cutoff. Write the total energy (in Ry) to a text file.
description: Intermediate total energy of the 64-atom bulk Si supercell.

title: DFT total-energy of Si self-interstitial (65 atoms)
action: Perform DFT total-energy calculations for a 65-atom Si self-interstitial supercell in the neutral <110> dumbbell configuration. Run both LDA and GGA exchange-correlation functionals separately. Write the LDA total energy (Ry) and the GGA total energy (Ry) to separate text files.
description: Intermediate total energies of the Si self-interstitial supercell, needed for formation energy and binding energy formulas.

title: DFT total-energy of substitutional C (Si63C)
action: Perform DFT total-energy calculation for a 64-atom supercell containing one substitutional C atom (Si63C) using the LDA functional. Write the total energy (Ry) to a text file.
description: Intermediate total energy of the substitutional C supercell.

title: DFT total-energy of C interstitial (Si64C, <001> split)
action: Perform DFT total-energy calculation for a 64-atom supercell containing a C interstitial in the <001> split C-Si pair configuration using the LDA functional. Write the total energy (Ry) to a text file.
description: Intermediate total energy of the C interstitial supercell.

title: DFT total-energy of C_i migration intermediate (C2 symmetry)
action: Perform DFT total-energy calculation for a 64-atom supercell containing the C_i migration intermediate with C2 symmetry using the LDA functional. Write the total energy (Ry) to a text file.
description: Intermediate total energy of the C migration intermediate supercell.

title: DFT total-energy of Si self-interstitial in +2 charge state (65 atoms)
action: Perform DFT total-energy calculation for a 65-atom Si self-interstitial supercell in the neutral <110> dumbbell configuration but with a net charge of +2, using a uniform neutralizing background charge. Use the LDA exchange-correlation functional with converged k-points and plane‑wave cutoff. Write the total energy (in Ry) to a text file.
description: Intermediate total energy of the Si self-interstitial in +2 charge state.

title: DFT total-energy of substitutional B in −1 charge state (Si63B)
action: Perform DFT total-energy calculation for a 64-atom supercell containing one substitutional B atom (Si63B) in the −1 charge state, using a uniform neutralizing background charge. Use the LDA exchange-correlation functional. Write the total energy (Ry) to a text file.
description: Intermediate total energy of the substitutional B in −1 charge state.

title: DFT total-energy of B_s–Si_i complex in +1 charge state (Si64B)
action: Perform DFT total-energy calculation for a 65-atom supercell containing the B_s–Si_i complex (substitutional B with an interstitial Si near a tetrahedral site) in the +1 charge state, using a uniform neutralizing background charge. Use the LDA exchange-correlation functional. Write the total energy (Ry) to a text file.
description: Intermediate total energy of the B_s–Si_i complex in +1 charge state.

title: Derive carbon and boron defect energetics
action: Read the total energies from all previous DFT steps. Compute the Si self-interstitial formation energy E_f(Si_i) (eV) using the GGA total energy of the 65-atom neutral Si interstitial and the LDA bulk Si energy, with E_f = E(Si65_gga) - (65/64)*E(Si64). Compute the C interstitial binding energy E_b(C_i) (eV) using LDA total energies: E_b = E(Si65_lda) + E(Si63C) - E(Si64C) - E(Si64). Compute the C_i migration barrier E_m(C_i) (eV) as the difference between the LDA total energy of the migration intermediate and the LDA total energy of the C interstitial. Compute the C diffusion activation energy E_a = E_f(Si_i) - E_b(C_i) + 0.8 eV (using the experimental C_i migration barrier 0.8 eV). Additionally, compute the B_s–Si_i binding energy E_b(BSi) (eV) using LDA total energies: E_b(BSi) = E(Si65_p2) + E(Si63B_m1) - E(Si64B_p1) - E(Si64). Write a JSON object containing all raw total energies (Ry) and the five derived quantities (eV) to defect_energies.json.
description: JSON file containing DFT total energies of all supercells and derived carbon and boron defect energetics.
output_schema: JSON object with keys: E_Si64 (Ry), E_Si65 (Ry, LDA neutral Si_i), E_Si63C (Ry), E_Si64C (Ry), E_intermediate (Ry), E_Si65_p2 (Ry, Si_i +2 charge), E_Si63B_m1 (Ry, substitutional B -1 charge), E_Si64B_p1 (Ry, B_s-Si_i complex +1 charge), E_f_Si_i (eV), E_b_Ci (eV), E_m_Ci (eV), E_a (eV), E_b_BSi (eV).
